title: RSF Attack on Umm Badr Gold Market Kills 5, Wounds 27, Sudanese Civil Group Says
detail: A Rapid Support Forces attack on a gold mining market and surrounding shops in Umm Badr, North Kordofan state, killed five civilians and wounded twenty-seven others on September 21, 2026, according to the Sudanese civil society group Dar Hamar Emergency Room, which accused RSF fighters of looting the market during the raid. The attack came just days after the Sudanese army announced its largest North Kordofan territorial gains in months, retaking 11 areas near Sodari, Umm Badr and Hamrat al-Sheikh on September 17 and the al-Jamama commercial hub on September 19 — activists said the raid appeared to be a reprisal by RSF elements against the area amid the army's advance. The RSF did not respond to the allegations.
